date.as_written: samvatasarā (!) 〈〈..〉〉 vedanāgagraha || āṣāḍhaśuklapratīpadāḥ (!) mṛgaśiri-ṇakṣatra (!) | vṛddhiyoga | magalavāra (!)

notes: The date is expressed in a chronogram: veda (4), nāga (8), graha (9). Read straight left-to-right as 489 (suggested by the catalogue, ca. 1369 CE), or in reverse order (aṅkānām vāmato gatiḥ) as 984 (ca. 1864 CE). No personal names are mentioned; 'leṣijaśu' appears to be a scribal error for the Newari formula 'lekhita juro' (was written). The rest of the colophon contains orthographical rules in Newari.
